prompt:
Professional fashion photograph, full body shot. TWO women, one seated on a stone throne and one kneeling at her feet.

#1: a real adult Yoruba Nigerian woman in her early 40s, her face exactly the same tone as her body, real skin texture with visible pores and fine grain, rich deep brown skin with a golden highlighter on the cheekbones, warm gold and bronze eyeshadow blended up to the brow bone, sharply defined arched brows, a precise winged liner, long dramatic lashes, large eyes with bright real catchlights, a deep wine-red glossy lip, a large sculpted gele head-wrap of stiff gold-and-cream fabric folded high above her head, a poised, joyful, radiant expression, demure and soft, low bun hair, real living eyes. Long round nails, glossy finish.
#1: Physique: An extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person. Both her bust and her hips are simultaneously, dramatically enormous — a colossal heavy bust resting full and wide, and enormous round hips flaring just as dramatically wide below — but unlike a sharply cinched hourglass, her waistline stays soft and only gently defined between them, a full, natural figure rather than a snatched one. Gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms, a full round face. Her head looks small on top of her massive body. Her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other.
#1: Body Art: Her bare skin is painted in Russian Palekh miniature lacquer — a deep black ground with fine gold linework and firebirds, wide gold bands following every deep crease and curving around the hips and thighs like contour lines, dense jewel-toned scenework filling the space between every band. The paint is pigment sitting on living skin, so it distorts slightly over every bulge. The paint covers her whole body with no bare skin left anywhere below the jaw: shoulders, upper arms, forearms, backs of her hands, sides, back, rear, lower belly, knees, calves and the tops of her feet. Her face is left unpainted and the pattern fades out at the neck with no hard line.
#1: Restraints: Her wrists wear heavy medieval hinged wrought-iron fetters, wide rough-forged iron bands closed with a thick iron pin and riveted, each with a heavy iron ring, each ring linked by a short heavy chain of massive thick black wrought-iron links, each link as thick as a thumb down to its own huge black iron ring bolted into the flagstone floor on its own side in front of her, her arms stretched down and slightly apart. Pose: kneeling upright on both knees on the flagstone floor at the foot of the throne, facing the camera, her shoulders drawn back, her chin lifted, her arms stretched down and slightly forward by the chains, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
#1: Footwear: pointed clear stiletto pumps, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.

#2: a luminous light-neutral complexion with a soft peach-beige undertone, late 20s goddess, hourglass SSBBW physique THE MOST EXTREME PHYSICALLY POSSIBLE beyond all anatomy limits — an extraordinarily large woman, far beyond any real person; a colossal heavy bust far wider than her shoulders, and below it a waistline that still draws in clearly even at this size; below that waistline a great mass of soft heavy fat sits on her middle and drops down under its own weight, projecting forward past the line of her own knees, gathering into two or three heavy rounded folds, not pregnant; enormous round hips more than three times the width of that waistline, gigantic soft thighs pressed together, very thick soft arms; her head looks small on top of her massive body; her arms, hands, legs and feet stay in correct proportion to each other; every fold and curve keeps its own clear rounded outline with a deep shadowed crease between them, never merging into one shapeless mass, the sheer weight of the flesh visible in how it spills forward and settles; real photographic skin with visible pores and fine grain, natural creases and shadow where the flesh folds, faint stretch marks where the great curves have expanded, long wavy dark brown hair — wearing a minimal brown leather pirate costume of a tiny lace-up bustier of two small opaque molded cups, a brown leather micro-mini skirt with its hem at the very top of her thighs, a wide belt with a gold buckle and a black tricorn pirate hat, fully opaque and covering only what it must, her stomach bare. She wears a wide black leather collar with a polished steel ring at the front, snug around her neck. She sits tall on the throne with her legs crossed at the knee, a slender black leather riding crop with a small flat leather tip resting across her knee in her right hand, her left hand resting on the stone armrest. Pose: seated upright on the stone throne facing the camera, her legs crossed at the knee, her chin lifted, her chest, shoulders and stomach fully in view.
#2: Footwear: pointed stiletto pumps made of glossy brown leather, each with a thin tapered six-inch heel, her feet resting naturally.
#2: Nails: the longest nails physically imaginable, almond nails each as long as her forearm is wide, in glossy brown leather with a high polish.
#2: Jewelry: a pearl choker and a long strand of pearls hanging low on her chest, thick polished gold bangles stacked on both wrists, and sculpted gold armbands high on both upper arms. Jewelry is metal and pearl only, worn on the body, nothing added to her face or ears.
#2: Face: her face is bare of any garment — real living flesh with real pores, a soft sheen of natural oils and bright real catchlights, the face of a real Korean woman (East Asian Korean features: a slim V-line face with a small tapered chin and smooth forehead, large double-lidded eyes with soft fullness under them, a straight narrow nose bridge with a small rounded tip, softly full lips, gently straight eyebrows), an unmistakably feminine face with a calm, composed expression, makeup: very dewy glass skin with a strong luminous highlight on the cheekbones, nose bridge and forehead, a rosy blush, glossy coral lips.

Environment: a medieval stone dungeon torture chamber with a heavy carved stone throne with high stone arms and a high stone back set against a rough-cut stone block wall, iron torch sconces with flickering flames on the stone walls, old iron tools hanging on the stone wall, a damp flagstone floor, dark and moody firelight.
All: Extreme macro detail on every surface texture and shadow. TWO completely different extreme physiques must CONTRAST and DOMINATE every inch of frame. Full-length wide shot from a moderate distance with the camera at waist height, the seated woman and the kneeling woman both completely visible from their feet to the top of their heads, with the stone walls, the vaulted ceiling and the flagstone floor around them at normal human scale. 8K portrait 3:4 aspect ratio.
